subject: Mathematics
title: Matrix Arithmetic
description: This set of notes introduces matrix arithmetic and explains a cache-friendly three-thread method for multiplying row-major matrices without copying or transposing either input matrix.
objectives: Perform matrix addition, subtraction, and scalar multiplication
Determine whether two matrices have compatible dimensions for multiplication
Compute a matrix product using row and column dot products
Explain how loop order affects the memory access pattern of matrix multiplication
Divide matrix multiplication safely among three threads
Understand identity matrices, transposes, inverses, and matrix powers
prerequisites: Basic understanding of rows and columns
Basic understanding of computer memory and threads
